summary: Okanogan County summit cabin, 12x12 ft, built 1922 or 1925 (sources differ); gone by 1958, remnants reported; trail from Forest Road 31 with no permit needed.

facts.status_note: Cabin gone since 1958; one hike write-up describes a few remaining remnants on the summit

access.note: Hike from Forest Road 31 off Highway 20; both hike write-ups say no permit is required

visit.drive_up: Forest Road 31 south from Highway 20 near milepost 293.5; trail starts 0.4 mile up the road
visit.trail_note: 4.8 miles round trip with 2,200 feet of climbing; trail can be faint in places

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1923 note says the cabin was built the previous fall, and the Willhite page says fall 1922, so 1922 is the better-supported date. The register and firelookout.com give 1925; we have not found a source that explains that date.
All sources agree the lookout was gone by 1958. The register says removed; firelookout.com, Willhite and Out There say destroyed.

notes_for_editor: Build year disputed: 1922 (Willhite, 1923 note) vs 1925 (register, firelookout.com). Fate verb disputed (removed vs destroyed), both 1958. Out There article is undated in our copy; the remnants claim may be old. Access marked public from two hike write-ups saying no permit is required, not from an agency statement; no closure found. Sweat Creek spelled Sweet on the Willhite page. Willhite notes the 1958 loss and 1928 staffing; firelookout.com adds names not on Willhite (Sprengle 1923, Martinez 1929, Lacoy 1945, Julian 1957); Hills is on both. No photos added. WTA page not read (Colville NF listing per search snippet only).
